title: HealETH
tagline: Elevate Minds, Empower Lives: Your Well-Being, Secured by Blockchain.
description:
Mental Health issue is a very critical and private problem. Everyone hesitates before sharing or opening in front of anyone. There is a need for a secure and private room where people can talk their hearts out without the fear of their conversations getting leaked or being heard by anyone other than the psychiatrists. 
The lack of methods to generate summary reports of real-time consultations and appointments and it's secure storage without exposing the user/patient's data or identity dealing with mental illness.
